documentUrls.title: Document URLs (PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP)
documentUrls.description: One or more direct URLs to invoices, receipts, or multi-page PDFs.

fileBase64.title: Or Base64-Encoded File (Optional — Great for AI Agents / MCP)
fileBase64.description: Optional base64 string (or data URI) of a PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP file if not using documentUrls.

fileName.title: Filename for Base64 Upload (Optional)
fileName.description: Example: invoice.pdf or receipt.jpg (defaults to document.pdf if omitted).

jsonSchema.title: Custom JSON Schema (Optional)
jsonSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema string. Leave empty to use the built-in Invoice & Line-Items schema.

mathRules.title: Custom Math Checksum Rules (Optional)
mathRules.description: Optional JSON array of declarative arithmetic rules. Leave empty for standard qty * unit_price == line_total & subtotal + tax == total checks.
